description: Top-10 holder addresses classified as non-private (exchange, market maker, treasury/vesting, liquidity pool, staking, bridge, burn, multisig) and therefore excluded from the reported concentration figure. Rows carry the label text our classifier matched on so the decision can be audited; older rows store it as a single combined `matchedLabel` string built from the provider's entity and address-label fields rather than either field verbatim, while newer rows carry `entity` and `ownerLabel` separately.
caveat: Classification depends on public address labels. An unlabelled custodial wallet is counted as private, so this list is a floor rather than a complete accounting.
